title: Match the launch screen to the first screen

statement.en: Design the launch screen to closely match the app or game's first screen.
statement.ja: launch screenをappまたはgameのfirst screenに近づけてdesignする。

conditions: Prevent an unpleasant flash when the launch screen transitions to the first screen.
If the app initially shows only a solid color, use only that color on the launch screen.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Launching experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるLaunchingの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。

title: Consider launching an immersive visionOS app in the Shared Space
